headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of June 17, 2026, the portfolio set has achieved an average return of 14.67%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 9.35%. This results in an average alpha of 5.32%, indicating that the portfolios are not only rising in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 28.63%, contributing a dollar change of $286.26. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 7.91%, showing a more modest performance. Outperformance against SPY is particularly relevant during periods of market stress, as it highlights the portfolio's resilience in uncertain conditions. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
